tests.title: Click nested directory then text file, verify path/content/reload and hide file on branch without it
checks: Directory listing shows the seeded nested directory and text file as links with exact accessible names
File page displays current branch, full-path breadcrumbs, and the saved text content as a complete visible value
Reloading the file page retains the same branch, path, and text content
Switching to feature-search, which lacks the file, removes the file link and content from the Code view
No write operation or commit is created while browsing files

tests.title: Open repository Commits history and file-scoped history; verify newest-first rows, commit detail, and reload stability
checks: Clicking Commits shows branch history with newest commits first
Each row displays short hash, commit message 'Document search flow', author, and relative time containing 'ago'
File-scoped history shows only commits that modified that file and excludes unrelated commits
Clicking a commit opens its detail page showing parent revision and changed files
Refreshing the history page preserves commit order, messages, and changed-file information

tests.title: Open commit diff from history or Compare; verify src/search.ts, changed-files summary, line counts, and no modifications
checks: Clicking the commit short hash or selecting base/compare and clicking Compare opens the diff page
Diff page displays base and compare identifiers and 'Changed files' summary
Changed-file path 'src/search.ts' appears as exact text with added/deleted lines for the file
Unchanged files do not appear in the changed-files list
Refreshing or returning to history does not modify commits, branches, or files; unauthorized revisions are not displayed

tests.title: Search code term, filter by src path, open matching file, and confirm no private-repository leakage
checks: Repository Search box accepts the query and pressing Enter exposes a unique Code results link
Path filter 'src/' restricts results to matching files in the current repository under that path
Results show snippet, file path, and branch/revision context; file links have exact accessible names
Clicking a result opens the matching file near the match with the query text visible
No content from unauthorized private repositories appears; search writes no commits or files

tests.title: Search absent query 'no-such-token' shows 'No code results' and retains exact query and filters
checks: Entering 'no-such-token' and opening Code results shows the empty state 'No code results'
Search box retains the exact query 'no-such-token'
Repository scope and path/language filters remain unchanged
No file is opened and no stale result appears

tests.title: Signed-in authorized search opens README.md match and persists file context/text after reload
checks: Signing in as alice-dev and opening repository acme-docs allows searching with 'search flow'
Result link has accessible name exactly 'README.md' and opens the matching file
File page displays 'search flow' as complete visible text
Reloading the file page preserves branch, path, and text, and the exact file link remains available
Search does not create commits or modify files

tests.title: Repeat absent code search after returning to repository shows same empty state without stale matches
checks: Searching 'no-such-token' first shows 'No code results' and retains the query
Returning to the repository and repeating the same search again shows 'No code results'
No stale match from the previous search is displayed
The repository scope and exact query remain unchanged; no file is opened

tests.title: Switch from main to feature-search via Branch selector, verify file-list/content change and branch heads unchanged
checks: Branch selector button accessible name is 'Branch main'; Find branch textbox filters options as typed
Selecting option 'feature-search' changes selector to 'Branch feature-search' and displays branch-only file link 'main-only.md'
Selector lists both 'main' and 'feature-search' and marks the current branch
Selecting 'main' again restores main's file content
No commit is created and neither branch head is changed by switching

tests.title: Enter unmatched branch query in selector shows no-matching state and preserves active branch after close/reload
checks: Opening selector and typing unknown branch term displays empty/no-matching branch state
Closing with Escape does not change the original active branch shown on the selector
Reloading the Code page retains the original active branch
No branch is created or selected as current

tests.title: Create branch feature/api-v2 from main head via selector, switch to it, and persist after reload
checks: Typing 'feature/api-v2' in Find branch exposes option 'Create branch: feature/api-v2' without Enter
Selecting that option creates the branch at the current main branch-head commit and switches the selector/page to it
Branch detail/base commit equals the original main head; main history and files are not rewritten
Refreshing the branch selector and page keeps 'feature/api-v2' selected and listed
Empty, invalid, duplicate, or permission-denied names show an error and create no branch

tests.title: Enter invalid..branch in branch selector immediately shows 'Invalid branch' and creates no branch
checks: Typing 'invalid..branch' immediately displays the visible error 'Invalid branch'
No 'Create branch: invalid..branch' option is displayed
Current branch remains the original branch after closing and reloading
No new branch reference is created; branch list and commit history are unchanged

tests.title: Admin changes default branch from main to release in Settings → Branches, confirms, and new default persists after reload
checks: Settings → Branches renders native 'Default branch' select with options 'main' and 'release'
Selecting 'release', clicking Update, and confirming saves release as default
Opening repository without a branch shows 'Branch release'; selector still offers 'main'
Refreshing settings shows default branch still 'release'
'main' branch and its commit history remain available and unchanged

tests.title: Non-Admin sees no default-branch selector/update control or rejection leaves default unchanged
checks: Signed-in non-admin opening Branches page has no 'Default branch' combobox or update button rendered
Attempting to submit a default-branch change is rejected by the server
Saved default branch remains 'main' after reload
Existing branches and commits are unchanged

tests.title: Add docs/guide.md via Add file, commit with non-empty message, verify new commit/content persist and branch head moves
checks: Clicking Add file → Create new file opens fields File name, File contents, Commit message and button Commit changes
Submitting path 'docs/guide.md' with content and a 1-72 character message creates a commit whose parent is original branch head
Branch head updates to the new commit; file page displays the exact saved content and commit history shows the exact message
Refreshing file page and history preserves the new file and commit
Invalid/conflicting path, empty message, protected branch, or persistence failure leaves file, branch head, and history unchanged

tests.title: Submit ../invalid.md with content and no commit message shows invalid path/required message and changes nothing
checks: Entering path '../invalid.md', content 'must not be saved', and empty commit message then clicking Commit changes displays 'Invalid file path' and/or 'Commit message is required'
No commit is created for the invalid submission
File '../invalid.md' does not appear in the repository after reload
Branch head and existing commit history remain unchanged
